_about: Divine epiphanies and the cards that can get them. Each effect has the conditions of the game's divine epiphany table (datamine: arca.live/b/chaoszeronightmare/157993488): card type, cost range, what the card must do (cure: heals, shield: gives a shield, draw: draws, targetable: the version's own text hits one chosen enemy — an Attack dealing Damage, a Skill naming the target or hitting several times (× N), not all enemies; kw:Keyword: the card has that keyword — Kyrken's Decrease Stress by 5 needs Exhaust); forbids: what the card must not do (a card that already draws gets no draw effect; taking a card from the Draw Pile to hand counts as a draw: the neutral card Attack! gets none; so does gaining Flame Arts: Fei's Night Rain II and V get none, IV too by a third-party site — not its Streak). A neutral card gets the same effects, Caligo's Treated as a Neutral Card included (Attack!). includeCards: card versions offered the effect although they do not meet requires. Every effect of a card's pool has the same chance (1 / size of the pool). An X-cost card counts as 0 (Soulfire Dance IV: Gain 1 AP, no Reduce Cost). A divine epiphany only goes on a card that has an epiphany (its own I–V or a common one). gods: "all" = each of the six gods offers it. seen: cards whose in-game probability screen shows it (screenshots; the screen leaves out an effect the card already has, for every god), the proof that the effect and its conditions are right. An effect applying a keyword the card already has is left out (Retain on Blessing of Waves I). excludeCards: card versions ("Name II") the game leaves it out for although they meet the conditions (an exclusion tag of the card).
